question.prompt: Approve this contract: recursive discovery must apply the initialization-time captured ignore-path patterns, matching them against project-relative paths in both POSIX and Windows forms; therefore, with project configuration `ignore-paths = ["^src/gen/.*$"]`, `pylint --recursive=y src/` must exclude `src/gen/` and its Python files. Scope is limited to recursive ignore-path handling and regression coverage. Acceptance requires an end-to-end test loading the anchored pattern from project configuration, proving the generated subtree is absent while a non-ignored file remains linted, plus preservation of existing recursive-ignore tests. Implementation may choose the internal path-normalization/refactoring approach but must not change `ignore`, `ignore-patterns`, configuration precedence, or non-recursive semantics. Residual risk is limited to previously unspecified recursive behavior for anchored ignore-path patterns, which intentionally changes to the approved project-relative basis.
